description: This file defines a PHP class 'PurgeCandidateModel' within the OrangeHRM Maintenance API namespace. The class implements serialization of a purge candidate entity, specifically wrapping a vacancy ID into an array structure for API purposes. It utilizes annotations for OpenAPI documentation and adheres to the Normalizable interface from the OrangeHRM core API.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateModel
classes.description: Represents a purge candidate for maintenance API with a vacancy ID, providing a method to convert its data to an array formatted for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PurgeCandidateModel with a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object's data into an associative array suitable for API response.
